changelog:
Initial release of recurring-content-calendar: automate creation, design, and scheduling of recurring social posts across major platforms via PostNitro.

- Build and manage a dynamic content calendar with unique, fresh posts each run.
- Supports carousels, single-image posts, and short videos for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and Threads.
- Customizable per-user settings: brand, audience, cadence, voice, platforms, topics, and scheduling.
- Features robust error handling, content deduplication, and publishing audit.
- Requires explicit brand and audience input; avoids hardcoded or reused sensitive data.
summary: Build and run a recurring social content calendar — designed carousels, single-image posts, and short videos, written fresh each run and scheduled ahead to LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and Threads. Use this skill whenever the user wants a content calendar, a daily or weekly posting routine, automate
